User Content

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML page that embeds the provided user input. Parameters ---------- user_input : str Content supplied by a user. It may contain characters that need escaping. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content safely inserted. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS or HTML injection. safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Inject the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
